nodes.label: Node Kinds (idea/project/study/path)
nodes.rationale: Each kind unlocks distinct capabilities (checklist for project, progress counter for study, nesting for path) so the data model matches what's actually being tracked instead of one generic node type.

nodes.label: Promote (in-place kind change)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the same row/id/edges so committing to an idea doesn't lose its connections; changing kind only drops data the new kind genuinely can't hold.

nodes.label: Focus Tier (primary/secondary/background)
nodes.rationale: Kept orthogonal to status so what's actionable and what's prioritized are tracked independently.

nodes.label: Blocked (derived state)
nodes.rationale: Computed at query time from unmet requires edges rather than stored, so it can never drift out of sync with the dependency graph.

nodes.label: Poke (append-only touch log)
nodes.rationale: Decoupled from updated_at so 'last touched' reflects a deliberate work signal, not an incidental field edit.

nodes.label: ts-rs Type Generation
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for the API contract: Rust request/response structs generate the frontend's TS types instead of hand-duplicated interfaces drifting out of sync.

nodes.label: sqlx Compile-Time-Checked Queries
nodes.rationale: No ORM; query!/query_as! macros catch SQL errors at compile time, with the .sqlx cache committed so CI builds offline without a live database.

nodes.label: Password + Argon2id + JWT Auth
nodes.rationale: Short-lived access token plus a rotated refresh token in an httpOnly Secure cookie limits the blast radius of a leaked token.

nodes.label: Three-Service Docker Compose Deployment
nodes.rationale: Backend, frontend, and database as separate containers behind a host nginx that already terminates TLS, images published to GHCR.

nodes.label: Board Views (Dashboard/Organized/Canvas/Timeline)
nodes.rationale: All three board views share one filter/search bar so switching views never resets what you're looking at.
